chunks: And he, peace be upon him, ruled regarding a man who ordered his servant to kill a man, and he said:
Is a man's servant anything but like his sword and his whip? The master is executed for it, and the servant is consigned to prison until he dies.

key_terms.السَّيِّدُ: the master who issued the command
key_terms.عَبْدَهُ: his servant or slave, the subordinate commanded to carry out the killing
key_terms.كَسَيْفِهِ وَ سَوْطِهِ: like his sword and whip, meaning an instrument used by the master
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ السَّيِّدُ بِهِ: the master is executed on account of it

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man orders his servant to kill someone?
ai.summary: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام gave a legal ruling about a master who commanded his servant to commit murder. The ruling places primary liability on the master as the directing agent, while the servant is imprisoned, reflecting a judicial distinction between command responsibility and direct execution of the act.
